programmes.d: An orphan revives her mother's criminal group 'Jack Squad' with fresh faces and updated schemes, unaware that the syndicate that killed her parents is still looking for revenge
Young pastry chef, Ronnie, dreams of opening her own bakery, but friends, family, and her love life have plans of their own.

Things start going well for a woman selling guns until Shanice's boyfriend, Marquis, finds out the truth. Marquis and his cousin Berg then decide they are going to steal the guns from the woman and set up their own operation.
Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted.

A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.
Married owners of a thriving tech empire bring aboard an elusive private secretary, who has an agenda of her own.

A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her.

Fading romance author Rebecca Sinclair concocts a desperate plan to reignite her dwindling career and fractured marriage. She creates a web of lies and her twisted plot leaves her trapped in a nightmare of her own making.

Ashton, Isaac, and Terrell have dreams of making it big in the gospel music industry, and making an impact in the world; however, worlds collide when they meet the nefarious founder and owner of Titan Records, Rodney "Rod" Wallace.
Held hostage in a diner, ten very different people, learn they have more in common than it appears.

A medical assistant with dreams of being a poet, falls deeply for her new boyfriend. When she puts her dreams aside and him first, it leads her to find out that her prince charming is not so charming after all.
A new comer to a company climbs the corporate ladder very quickly, but pays a cost behind closed doors to get there.
Gianna will never forget the day her father was killed. Years later, she finds the murderer back in her life.
